Sandbox_VICCSSpores_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or disables airborne spore simulation and biohazard risk.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_CarrierChance_toolti: Probability (0 to 1) of a zombie emitting airborne spores when moving.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_DoseThreshold_toolti: Total quantity of spores your lungs can endure before irreversible zombification.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_DoseRecovery_tooltip: Amount of accumulated spore dose purged when breathing 100% clean air.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_CorpseDecayDays_tool: How many in-game days an infected carcass continues emitting spores.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_DecontamPower_toolti: Reduction of spore concentration in a cell when spraying bleach.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_MaxActiveCells_toolt: Performance safety cap to prevent CPU stuttering in busy worlds and servers.
Sandbox_VICCSSpores_ReduceFX_tooltip: Disables dense ground spore fog rendering for visual sensitivity or FPS boost.
